premises.text: Software built by a grower for growers uniquely fits farm workflows
premises.evidence_span: it was built by a grower for growers, by a farmer for farmers. And that makes it one of a kind

premises.text: Farms must track who does what, when, and where for H-2A labor compliance and operations
premises.evidence_span: AgriTrack captures the most vital data that farmers need, which is labor. In other words, who is doing what, when, and where

premises.text: Most farms still use pen and paper, which makes compliance impractical and audits often find violations
premises.evidence_span: 84% of farms today are still tracking everything with pen and paper

premises.text: Dashboard, field tablet with NFC clock-in, and geotagged phone apps digitize labor data into one system
premises.evidence_span: Agritrack accomplishes this in three different apps

premises.text: Labor audit reports package Department of Labor–ready documentation on demand
premises.evidence_span: the labor audit report. It's named that way for a reason, because it has everything that's in step with the Department of Labor

premises.text: Software calculates hour, piece-rate, and overtime pay so payroll that took a day finishes in minutes
premises.evidence_span: what used to take a day or more to run payroll and do that process is now actually being done in minutes with AgriTrack

value.text: Farms get accurate, compliance-ready labor data and faster payroll with confidence
value.evidence_span: farms can utilize AgriTrack to have confidence in the data that they're collecting, knowing that it's accurate

causal_links.evidence_span: So AgriTrack helps solve this problem by digitizing the whole process
We do all the heavy lifting for them
